name: Covert

source.title: Pathfinder rules text (Foundry PF2E trait descriptions)

text: This armor can be easily concealed when not in use. You can hide the armor on your person using Conceal an Object as if it were of light Bulk and can do so while still wearing it, though it provides no item bonus to your AC while hidden. The armor can be retrieved from its hiding place with an Interact action.
